scene: The brass clock chimes, releasing a tiny fluttering mechanical hummingbird.
picture: A flat side-scrolling platform view. On the far left, a dropped golden winding key glints on the platform floor. Centre, the moustachioed grandfather in navy apron looks up beside his plant-laden bicycle. Up high, a mechanical brass hummingbird hovers near the ornate ticking clock. On the far right, an ornate brass turnstile gate stands closed.
